callees.name: _SourceIndex.build
callees.pre_condition: source is a non-empty string containing source code text.
callees.post_condition: Returns a _SourceIndex instance that indexes the source text by line boundaries, enabling position-to-offset and range-to-source queries for the given source.

callees.name: _SourceIndex.position_to_offset
callees.pre_condition: self is a _SourceIndex instance built from the same source string handed to _position_to_offset. position is a dict with 'line' and 'character' entries (each defaulting to 0) representing a location in the indexed source.
callees.post_condition: Returns the zero-indexed byte offset in the indexed source corresponding to the given position, clamped to [0, len(source)]. Characters above U+FFFF count as 2 UTF-16 code units.
